market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off dominates: oil above $100, 10Y yield near 5%, Asian equities/bonds falling. Expect volatility spike (VIX >25) through Iran conflict resolution. Bessent credibility damage may force Fed to hold or hike, pressuring equities further. Yen strengthens on carry unwind. 1-3 month outlook is choppy and defensive.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict de-escalates, oil normalizes and bond yields stabilize, creating a relief rally. AI infrastructure (semiconductors) and nuclear energy remain structurally bullish. India large-caps benefit from diplomatic thaw. China battery moratorium supports global EV supply chain pricing. 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if geopolitical risk resolves.
